تستنجبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْجِبُوا (tastanjibū) /tas.tan.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# تُسْتَنْجَبُوا (tustanjabū) /tus.tan.d͡ʒa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
